outline:
1. Process Management

3. Memory Management

schedule:
Week  Topics
1  Course Overview
2  Chap. 1, Introduction
3  Chap. 2, Operating System Structures
Chap. 3, Processes
4  Chap. 4, Thread and Concurrency
5  Chap. 5, CPU Scheduling
6  Chap. 6, Synchronization Tools

14  Chap. 13, File System Interface

16 Chap. 15, File System Internals
17 Chap. 18, Virtual Machines
18 (Final Exam)
assessment:
Written and programming exercises: ~40%
Midterm exam: ~30%
Final exam: ~30%
